activeSlice.scope: Reduce Hunter V2 shadow evidence cost without changing rollout policy, production authority, EEI thresholds, persistence, or the certified six-item recommendation contract. Narrow only the operational evidence retrieval profile from three intents to two bounded intents: one core intent plus one reserved exploration intent.
successCriteria: Operational shadow evidence uses at most two paid Agent Reach intents per comparison.
The bounded operational plan reserves exactly one exploration intent whenever exploration evidence is available.
The existing explorationMin=0.08, explorationMax=0.20 and maximumTopicShare=0.34 remain unchanged.
A corrected 3x3 pre-gate returns six recommendations per run with exactly one exploration item (16.7%) and maximum observed topic share <=34%.
Average retrieval coverage remains >=0.85 and V2 failure rate remains <=0.05.
Average quality delta remains >=-0.02 and p95 latency ratio remains <=1.5.
Average cost ratio is <=1.5 before any full 30-pair gate.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence or canary enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
blockers: The 3x3 pre-gate cannot produce a valid relative cost or latency decision while the V1 control lane returns zero-cost, near-no-op observations for a Hunter-ready Brand.
Do not run the 30-pair gate until control comparability is explicitly restored without weakening rollout thresholds.
